notes: First checkpoint of the Amendment A depth-first completion pass. Roughly 30 web calls produced five accepted observations, a yield of about one usable observation per six calls, which implies the full pass at the Amendment B three-venue threshold would need on the order of 4,000 calls. Every measure in this batch rests on a single venue and is therefore below that threshold and provisional. The two cocktail observations apply the Amendment E1 within-venue rule: median of the venue's standard classic section with reserve, low-ABV, and zero-proof tiers excluded, and the section range retained in reportedLow and reportedHigh.
